# Premier Equipment LLC

> Premier Equipment LLC, Beachwood OH — buying and selling used injection molding machines for 55+ years

Premier Equipment LLC buys and sells inspected used injection molding machines from Beachwood, OH. Owner: Nicole Haas. 55+ years in plastics machinery. Shipped to 48 states. Certified appraisals (CMEA/USPAP/NEBB), documented condition reports, nationwide rigging and freight.

## What we do
- **We Buy Plastics Machinery** — Single machine, full plant, or anything in between. Fast, fair, paid on pickup.
- **We Sell Inspected Used Machines** — Every machine we list has documented true hours, a condition report, and a 30-day functional guarantee.
- **Certified Appraisals** — CMEA · USPAP-compliant valuations your bank, insurer, or court will accept.
- **Rigging & Nationwide Freight** — From the press floor to your loading dock, in one coordinated move.

## Inventory
- [300-Ton Van Dorn 300-RS](https://www.buypremier.com/machine/300-ton-van-dorn-300-rs.html): Reconditioned 300-ton hydraulic press, single-owner, runs clean.
- [500-Ton Milacron Magna 500](https://www.buypremier.com/machine/500-ton-milacron-magna-500.html): 500-ton toggle, recently serviced with new heater bands.
- [150-Ton Nissei FNX150](https://www.buypremier.com/machine/150-ton-nissei-fnx150.html): 150-ton all-electric, low hours, energy-efficient.
- [650-Ton Toshiba EC650](https://www.buypremier.com/machine/650-ton-toshiba-ec650.html): 650-ton electric, large-platen, ideal for automotive parts.
- [220-Ton Engel Victory 220](https://www.buypremier.com/machine/220-ton-engel-victory-220.html): 220-ton tie-bar-less, great for insert molding.
- [400-Ton Husky H400 RS](https://www.buypremier.com/machine/400-ton-husky-h400-rs.html): 400-ton servo, PET-capable, tight tolerances.
